data.narrative:
Bohr Systems is a pre-seed stage Defense & Security company founded by Rohil Gharat (former Antler, Founders Inc., Cisco) and Samarth Kumbla (Columbia CS '27). The valuation analysis draws from a universe of 22 same-sector peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms, with top private comparables including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Peer-Median methodology is not applicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables. Across Defense & Security, zero pre-seed peers, one adjacent-stage peer, and zero similar-valuation-tier peers were identified—below the minimum three-datapoint threshold required for reliable median triangulation. A fall-back to all-sector median would introduce substantial sector and stage heterogeneity, rendering results unreliable.

The absence of tight stage and valuation-tier comparables limits quantitative precision at this early stage. A credible valuation range would require either: (1) expansion to adjacent defense-tech sectors to build sufficient comparable density, (2) application of founder pedigree and market-size frameworks, or (3) reliance on industry standard pre-seed check sizes and dilution expectations. Without this additional methodology, specific valuation guidance cannot be supported by the data provided.
